resources.string:
W-GPSTest

 • Maps: updated Google Maps API configuration for W-GPSTest releases.

 • Overview: per-satellite signal strength, frequency bands, fix participation, and constellation filters with used/in-view counts.

 • Dashboard: ground speed, session average and maximum speed, course, altitude, accuracy, time, and coordinates. Units follow Settings; session speed statistics can be reset.

 • Interface: aligned the speed and course headings on the Dashboard. Removed the direction hint below the course reading and the GitHub and feedback drawer entries.

 • Help: updated the release notes and About page with W-GPSTest information. Fixed the top of the About text being hidden behind the app bar on newer Android versions.

W-GPSTest

 An Android GNSS tool for viewing satellite signals, positioning status, and motion data.

 Overview and Dashboard
 Overview groups signals by satellite and shows constellation counts and filters. Dashboard shows speed, session statistics, course, altitude, accuracy, time, and coordinates.

 GNSS tools
 Includes Status, Map, Sky, Accuracy, assistance data tools, and logging. Available data depends on the device and reception conditions.

 Credits and license
 Based on GPSTest by Sean J. Barbeau and contributors. W-GPSTest retains the upstream copyright notices and Apache License 2.0. W-GPSTest additions do not imply endorsement by the upstream authors.
